f32a8fc72bfb2af89efc06ef962972d63e2b5408.reference: Eleven last March; sixteen and three quarters in the later exchange. The difference is five and three quarters years.
f32a8fc72bfb2af89efc06ef962972d63e2b5408.answer: The first statement is "I was eleven years old last March." The second statement is "I'm thirteen and three quarters" and "I shall be sixteen and three quarters". The difference is 2 years.
